name: pulls_open_draft
description: Open one draft PR proposing a change in prose; no commits are needed. Use before the final comment, only when triage identifies a file; skip when file is none. Returns issue_id, pr_id, branch, draft=true and truncated=false; at most one receipt without echoing title or body. Empty branch, title or body is an error, never an empty success.

number.description: Positive issue number to target; use the assigned issue, not a guessed ID. Selects one issue per call.

branch.description: Use repomind/issue-<number> for the assigned issue. Identifies the proposed change; opening a PR writes to the mock remote.

title.description: Nonblank summary, at most 200 characters, for a reviewer to recognize the proposed change.

body.description: Nonblank proposal, at most 4000 characters, naming the repository file and describing the intended change. No actual patch or commit is required.

input.title: Clarify local startup instructions
input.body: Propose updating README.md to document the supported startup command after confirming it in package.json.

examples.note: Typical: when evidence supports a documentation change, open one draft proposal before posting the triage comment; no commit is required.

input.title: Review export cleanup behavior
input.body: Propose inspecting src/Report.ts and ensuring the export control is re-enabled after a failed request, if investigation confirms this is the responsible file.

examples.note: Hard case: a draft can propose a change in prose without a patch, but use this file only if investigation identified it. If the draft triage names none, do not call this tool. After a timeout, the harness must resolve the original write rather than the model inventing a new branch.
